prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished game prop concept sheet for BIGGAS hover racing. Title "01 · CHISPA". Subject: A compact chunky retro sci-fi energy dart, short cream-colored hexagonal body with a large cyan faceted crystal nose, two small orange rear fins and dark petrol mechanical collar. Reads as a playful racing powerup projectile, not realistic ammunition. Forward attack. Style: very low-poly retro videogame geometry, big planar facets, visibly pixelated painted textures, limited cream/orange/cyan/petrol palette, slight comic printed-paper character. Neutral light gray background. Exactly 2 aligned rows of 4 consistent views: top, front, left side, three-quarter perspective. Upper row labeled "CON TEXTURA", lower row "SIN TEXTURA". Lower row shows SAME geometry in plain gray clay with simple visible edges, no painted details. Consistent shapes and scale between all views. Large clear object views, generous gutters, restrained typography. No photorealism, no intricate greebles, no copied Mario or Crash assets. This is concept art for later modeling, not a Blender screenshot.
